text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What?
Shave off time... bit by bit on every corner?
This was the strategy I entrusted to Tap Dance City. Namely—
"Devising better ways to take each corner to shave off 0.2 seconds per turn."

A middle-distance race has 4 corners,
but a long-distance race has 6.
0.2 × 6 = we can gain "1.2 seconds."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I see! Slowly, slowly building up, and before you know it—KABOOM!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Count me in on that plan!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I see, what she's targeting isn't the pace,
but the course!
Dammiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Still, at this pace,
they're probably also...!"

The result was that neither Tap Dance City
nor Air Shakur managed to take the win...
It seems she got swept up in the very rapids that Tap Dance City herself created.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Still, I pretty much ran the way I wanted to!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch, stirring up chaos just as they please.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tell your Trainer this.
Next time, I won't let you have your way with a single thing.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That's how it is, Trainer.
Looks like we ended up going down together in the end, though...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, all they did was spook us, so
all right! No harm done.
And so, she thoroughly enjoyed the Kikuka Sho as a battle of logic versus logic.
